subject.title: fix(codex): heartbeat notifications to other channels are silently denied by cross-context policy

question: Should Codex heartbeat, cron, and inter-session turns carrying the internal WebChat transport marker be treated as having no current conversation provider, matching pre-v2026.6.9 and non-Codex behavior?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but this choice determines when the default cross-provider containment guard applies to autonomous agent activity and therefore requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Approve the narrow internal-turn exception
options.body: Treat only internal WebChat-marked heartbeat, cron, and inter-session turns as unbound while preserving containment for genuine WebChat and real-channel turns.

options.title: Require an additional constraint
options.body: Keep the PR open until the exception is further limited by an approved provenance, destination, or capability rule.

options.title: Retain default-deny behavior
options.body: Reject the exception and require operators to opt into cross-provider sends through existing configuration despite the regression from earlier releases.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow internal-turn exception
recommendation.body: Treat only internal WebChat-marked heartbeat, cron, and inter-session turns as unbound while preserving containment for genuine WebChat and real-channel turns.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work shows broad involvement in the Codex app-server runtime and tool-routing surface, making this the strongest available owner for the trust-boundary choice.
